spans.label: Crate imports and the canonical ChannelId re-export
spans.note: `use` lines. Everything imported here (keccak, Regev, BalanceState, ChannelId, the constants module) enters the model as an opaque field of `Env` or as a pinned literal; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SignatureBytes alias and drift-hazard comment
spans.note: Type alias plus comments; signature blobs are modeled as `List Nat` inside `MemberSignature`.

spans.label: Domain separators and channel-layer caps
spans.note: Every domain literal is pinned and proved pairwise distinct; the retired-tag comments are narrative only. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: ChannelError variants
spans.note: Error categories are modeled with per-message sub-faults; the `thiserror` Display strings themselves are not modeled.

spans.label: ChannelStatus / ProofBackend / TransitionProofRole / ChannelTransitionKind
spans.note: Discriminant codes are the `as u32` values that enter the envelope digest. serde renaming is not modeled.

spans.label: required_state_backend / required_transport_backend
spans.note: The kind-to-backend map is total and the two backends never cross roles. This says nothing about any proof actually verifying.

spans.label: ChannelProofEnvelope struct
spans.note: Proof bytes are an opaque `List Nat` payload.

spans.label: ChannelProofEnvelope::to_digest_words
spans.note: Role and backend tags precede the length-prefixed proof bytes. The byte-to-word packing is proved NOT injective, which is why the length prefix is load-bearing.

spans.label: ChannelId re-export commentary
spans.note: Comment block.

spans.label: ChannelRecord layout
spans.note: The 1024-wide pubkey array is a total index function; the digest reads exactly the first MAX_CHANNEL_MEMBERS positions. Field widths (u8/u16/u64) are represented as Nat plus the range checks the source itself performs.

spans.label: ChannelRecord::validate
spans.note: Executable translation in the source's early-return order, including the O(n^2) active-key scan. The extraction theorems state EXACTLY what acceptance forces; the three `*_unconstrained_*` / `*_substituted_*` theorems state what it does NOT force (no link between the recorded keys and either committed root, no key authenticity).

spans.label: ChannelRecord::signing_digest (IMCR preimage)
spans.note: The 8226-word preimage is reproduced limb for limb; both counts precede all 1024 hashes and regev_pk_root is last. The keccak application itself is the `Env.hash` boundary — no digest-level injectivity is claimed.

spans.label: MerkleInclusionProof
spans.note: Sibling list plus a 256-bit leaf index.

spans.label: SmallBlockRootMessage layout
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SmallBlockRootMessage::signing_digest (IMSB preimage)
spans.note: 41-word preimage. The claim that it matches the in-circuit recompute limb-for-limb is NOT proved here; the circuit side is modeled in Zkp.Implementation.BlockMessages.

spans.label: MemberSignature layout
spans.note: Slot, claimed pubkey hash and an opaque blob.

spans.label: SignedSmallBlock layout
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SignedSmallBlock::signing_digest (IMSS preimage)
spans.note: Includes the later-attached signature and proof blobs, each length-prefixed. This is why InterChannelTx binds the block MESSAGE digest instead.

spans.label: ChannelFund and single_token_amounts
spans.note: The per-token fund vector is always full ten-lane width. Cross-lane summation is absent from the model exactly as it is absent from the source.

spans.label: token_funds_digest (IMTF, fixed 92-word preimage)
spans.note: PREIMAGE injectivity in (registry, token_count, amounts) is proved by an explicit decoder. Digest-level non-aliasing would additionally need keccak collision resistance, which is a boundary and is NOT assumed.

spans.label: close_state_id (IMCS)
spans.note: The identity is a function only of channel, member-signed final IMCH digest and freeze nonce; the preimage is injective in all three on the native u64 range.

spans.label: ChannelBalance and ChannelMember structs
spans.note: Neither wire struct has a counterpart in this module. `channel_balance_leaf_digest` (the only function that consumes ChannelBalance-shaped data) IS modeled, at lines 1623-1646.

spans.label: ChannelState layout
spans.note: `Balance` carries only the three BalanceState fields channel.rs reads (h1 via the Env callback, state_version, settled_tx_chain) plus the registry/count that apply_token_register mutates; the rest of the BalanceState body is an opaque payload modeled in Zkp.Implementation.H1Gadget.

spans.label: ChannelState::signing_digest (IMCH preimage)
spans.note: 139-word preimage: the ten-lane fund vector at full width, balance h1 in the legacy balance-root slot, h2_tag and state_version appended at the end. That signing this digest covers both H1 and H2 is a statement about the PREIMAGE only; signature validity is a boundary.

spans.label: ChannelState::with_computed_digest
spans.note: The digest field is not part of its own preimage, so the assignment is not self-referential.

spans.label: Reject and RejectReason
spans.note: Off-chain rejection telemetry; no counterpart in this module and no digest depends on it.

spans.label: ChannelTx struct
spans.note: The wire struct itself is not re-modeled here (Zkp.Implementation.ChannelStateUpdate carries its own view of it); only its signing preimage is modeled, at lines 715-754.

spans.label: ChannelTx::signing_digest (IMPA-v2, 43 words)
spans.note: token_slot occupies limb 26 alone; two otherwise identical transfers with different token slots have different preimages. The proof envelope is deliberately outside the preimage.

spans.label: ReceiverBalanceDelta
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: InterChannelTx layout
spans.note: One scalar token_index and one receiver-delta list per descriptor, exactly as in the source. That a descriptor carries exactly ONE real receiver is a caller convention, not a type constraint, and is not asserted here.

spans.label: InterChannelTx::signing_digest (IMI5 preimage)
spans.note: Binds the block MESSAGE digest (not the SignedSmallBlock digest) and excludes the sender's own hash-signature fields. Hash-signature validity is a boundary.

spans.label: InterChannelTx::tx_leaf_hash
spans.note: Only receiver_deltas[0] is read; trailing deltas are ignored and an empty list is an error. `tx_leaf_hash` itself is the imported balance_state boundary.

spans.label: InterChannelTx::compute_tx_hash
spans.note: Single-sources token_index from the descriptor's own field; the token-bearing hash moves with it.

spans.label: InterChannelTx::replay_identity
spans.note: The identity is invariant under the token limb, which is what makes two token variants of one debit collide in an identity-keyed ledger. Whether any ledger actually keys on it is outside this file.

spans.label: burn_descriptor (IMD2)
spans.note: 28-word preimage, injective in all six inputs (source channel and base nonce included). The Solidity abi.encodePacked mirror is not proved equal.

spans.label: inter_channel_tx_hash and its ids word
spans.note: The ids word layout [0,0,0,0,0,token,dest,source] is pinned and injective. The two-step keccak fold uses the imported settled_tx_chain_push boundary.

spans.label: inter_channel_tx_identity
spans.note: Definitionally the token-bearing fold at token limb zero.

spans.label: CloseWithdrawal and its IMCL digest
spans.note: 42-word preimage; the zkp bytes are outside it.

spans.label: CloseIntent layout
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: CloseIntent::new binding checks
spans.note: All seven checks in source order plus the checked freeze-nonce increment. The last theorem records the scope limit: only the genesis fund lane is compared with burn_amount; the other nine ride into the snapshot unchecked here.

spans.label: CloseIntent::state_id / signing_digest
spans.note: The legacy name is definitionally the state id.

spans.label: WithdrawalClaim layout
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: WithdrawalClaim::derive_nullifier (IMW2, 18 limbs)
spans.note: The preimage is keyed on the slot Regev pk digest and carries token_slot as its own limb; member_pk_g never appears. That the Regev digest is leaf-bound is a property of the withdrawal-claim proof, not of this function.

spans.label: WithdrawalClaim::signing_digest (IMCW)
spans.note: token_slot sits at limb 17, immediately after member_pk_g. The source's own note that a v1 and a v2 preimage can share a total length under a realigned parse is NOT contradicted here: no cross-version non-aliasing is claimed.

spans.label: SpecialClose and its IMSC digest
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: CancelClose, CancelClose::new and its IMCN digest
spans.note: The constructor binds the revived tx by block-message digest, IMI5 digest, tx_hash and seal.

spans.label: PostCloseIncomingClaim layout
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: derive_shared_native_nullifier (IMCK)
spans.note: The 25-limb preimage carries no token limb; the source's argument that token separation follows transitively from incoming_tx_hash is recorded structurally and is NOT proved (it depends on the accumulator and the replay ledger, both outside this file).

spans.label: PostCloseIncomingClaim::signing_digest (IMCP)
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: TokenRegister payload struct
spans.note: The single-field payload wrapper is not modeled; its token_index is threaded directly into tokenRegisterNextState at lines 1463-1495.

spans.label: token_register_next_state
spans.note: The canonical builder's carry-over set is pinned field by field. `apply_token_register` (append-at-token_count, injectivity, version bump) is an Env boundary, so the registry invariants themselves are NOT proved here.

spans.label: ChannelTransition enum and its delegating accessors
spans.note: The payload-carrying wrapper and its kind()/backend delegations are not modeled; the underlying kind-to-backend map IS modeled, at lines 139-171.

spans.label: structural_cosign_placeholder
spans.note: An explicit non-signature of exactly the cosign blob length. Falcon decoding and verification are boundaries; nothing here says the blob is or is not a valid signature beyond its shape.

spans.label: validate_all_member_signatures (structural length gate)
spans.note: Adds only the fixed blob LENGTH on top of the slot check. Proved to be independent of the blob BYTES, and the source's own meaningless placeholder is proved to pass: acceptance here is NOT evidence of any signature.

spans.label: validate_member_signature_slots (structural slot gate)
spans.note: Runs record.validate() first, then one entry per cosigner slot, in slot order, with the registered pk_g and a non-empty blob. It constrains no slot at or above member_count, and performs no cryptographic verification.

spans.label: channel_balance_leaf_digest / user_fund_leaf_digest (IMUF)
spans.note: 18-word preimage; the ciphertext enters only through the opaque digest boundary.

spans.label: merkle_root_from_proof
spans.note: Bit selection from the big-endian index limbs is reproduced, INCLUDING the usize underflow for depth >= 256 (a panic, modeled as such). No Merkle soundness or inclusion property is claimed; the node hash is the Env.hash boundary.

spans.label: split_u64
spans.note: The big-endian pair, kept distinct from the low-limb-first split that the IML2 digest uses.

spans.label: bytes_to_u32_words
spans.note: Right-zero-padded 4-byte big-endian chunks; proved non-injective, which is the reason every variable-length blob in this file is length-prefixed.

spans.label: hash_words / solidity_keccak256
spans.note: Modeled as the opaque `Env.hash` callback. NOT assumed injective or collision-resistant, and the `expect("keccak output must be bytes32")` panic path is not modeled.

spans.label: close_member_set_commitment (IMCM, fixed 66-word preimage)
spans.note: Fixed-width over the MAX_SIG_CLUSTER cosigner slots with zeroed padding; delegates never enter it. Agreement with the in-circuit keccak gadget and the Solidity mirror is NOT proved.

spans.label: l1_deposit_import_digest (IML2, 14 words)
spans.note: token_index (limb 10) and depositor_slot (limb 13) are separate canonical limbs; the amount is split LOW LIMB FIRST here, unlike split_u64.

spans.label: #[cfg(test)] module
spans.note: Rust unit tests and fixtures, including the frozen cross-language golden vectors. Not a production constraint; the module's own example theorems are separate.

boundaries.name: keccak-hash-words
boundaries.obligation: `hash_words`/`solidity_keccak256` is an opaque `Env.hash` callback; no injectivity, collision resistance or preimage resistance is assumed, so no theorem here upgrades preimage distinctness into digest distinctness.

boundaries.name: regev-ciphertext-digest
boundaries.obligation: `RegevCiphertext::digest` is the opaque `Env.ctDigest`; nothing binds it to the ciphertext contents or to any decryptable amount.

boundaries.name: balance-state-h1
boundaries.obligation: `BalanceState::h1` is the opaque `Env.balanceH1`; the registry/token_count commitment it is claimed to carry is modeled in Zkp.Implementation.H1Gadget, not here.

boundaries.name: balance-state-tx-leaf-and-chain-push
boundaries.obligation: `tx_leaf_hash` and `settled_tx_chain_push` are imported opaque callbacks; the fold structure is modeled, the hash is not.

boundaries.name: balance-state-apply-token-register
boundaries.obligation: `BalanceState::apply_token_register` is an opaque callback; append-at-token_count, registry injectivity, the MAX_CHANNEL_TOKENS bound and the state_version bump are NOT proved in this module.

boundaries.name: falcon-signature-validity
boundaries.obligation: `validate_all_member_signatures` and `validate_member_signature_slots` are proved to check only slot order, registered pk_g and blob length. Actual N-of-N authorization rests on `wallet_core::verify_all_signatures` and the close/cancel aggregation circuits, which are outside this file.

boundaries.name: sender-hash-signature-and-a11-membership
boundaries.obligation: `sender_hash_sig` / `sender_pk_b` on ChannelTx and InterChannelTx are opaque bytes here; the Poseidon2-BabyBear STARK check and the (pk_g, pk_b, regev_pk) MemberLeaf membership proof are the wallet's and the verifier's obligation.

boundaries.name: registered-member-set-binding
boundaries.obligation: `ChannelRecord::validate` is proved NOT to relate `member_pk_gs` to `member_pubkeys_root`, to `regev_pk_root`, or to any on-chain registration. Binding the recorded keys to the registered cosigner set is done elsewhere (the IMCM public input matched on L1, the wallet member tree).

boundaries.name: merkle-tree-soundness
boundaries.obligation: `merkle_root_from_proof` is modeled as a fold; no statement is made that a matching root implies membership, nor that the leaf index is in range beyond the modeled panic.

boundaries.name: channel-id-validity
boundaries.obligation: `ChannelId` construction (nonzero, 32-bit range) lives in `common::channel_id`; this module represents a channel id as a bare Nat and only models the reserved-burn-id check that channel.rs itself performs.

boundaries.name: circuit-and-solidity-mirrors
boundaries.obligation: Claims that IMSB, IMCM, IMCK, IMTF or IML2 preimages match their in-circuit or Solidity recomputes limb-for-limb are documentation in the source; no cross-language equality is proved here.

boundaries.name: rust-runtime-and-serde
boundaries.obligation: serde encoding, allocation failure, error Display strings, integer-overflow build profile (modeled only as an explicit OverflowMode choice) and Rust compiler refinement are all outside the model.
